key_points: Corning partnered with Qualcomm and Lumentum to demo high‑density optical interconnects for AI data centers
Demo generated strong market reaction, stock up 5‑6% over two days
Signals Corning’s growing role in AI‑driven fiber infrastructure, a potential new growth avenue
No earnings or guidance change yet, so impact is primarily sentiment‑driven
Effect likely short‑to‑medium term as investors reassess growth outlook
